articles.title: Why petrol and diesel prices haven't fallen yet? Hardeep Singh Puri hints at rate cut after sustained low crude prices
articles.titleEn: Why petrol and diesel prices haven't fallen yet? Hardeep Singh Puri hints at rate cut after sustained low crude prices
articles.summary: Fuel prices might see a dip if international crude oil rates stay low for a few more weeks, according to Union Minister Hardeep Puri. Oil companies are currently using crude purchased at higher prices during the West Asia conflict, leading to past losses. However, sustained low global prices could pave the way for a reduction at the pump. India also plans to boost its oil storage capacity.

articles.title: Don't expect petrol and diesel prices to fall just yet: Hardeep Puri
articles.titleEn: Don't expect petrol and diesel prices to fall just yet: Hardeep Puri
articles.summary: Global crude oil prices have fallen to around $70 a barrel, but Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri says petrol and diesel prices are unlikely to be cut immediately because the fuel currently being sold was bought earlier at higher prices. He said any review of retail prices would depend on crude remaining at current levels for the next two to three months.
